records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, revenue increased $39 million or 6.6% and $18 million or 1.5%, respectively, and net income attributable to DNOW Inc. declined $10 million and $20 million, respectively, when compared to the corresponding periods of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We offer higher value solutions in key product lines in the U.S. which broaden and deepen our customer relationships and related product line value.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The average price per short ton of Hot-Rolled Coil declined 17.2% (from $961.95 per short ton to $796.03 per short ton) in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the first quarter of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The average price per barrel of West Texas Intermediate Crude increased 5.4% (from $77.56 per barrel to $81.71 per barrel), and average natural gas prices declined 2.3% (from $2.13 per MMBtu to $2.08 per MMBtu) in the second quarter of 2024 compared to the first quarter of 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, the Company generated an operating profit of $33 million and $61 million, respectively, compared to an operating profit of $36 million and $71 million, respectively, for the corresponding periods of 2023.
